title: Theta 6 Hz | Meditation and Creative Flow
description:
Meditation, creative flow, inner voice.

Theta runs about 4 to 8 Hz and rises in the borderland between waking and sleep, the hypnagogic state, and in deep meditative absorption. When two tones a few hertz apart are played one per ear, the auditory brainstem resolves a phantom beat at the difference frequency, and cortical firing starts to follow it. That is the frequency following response, and it is measured, not imagined. Theta is where the default mode network quiets and associative thinking loosens.

This session: 200 Hz in the left ear, 206.0 Hz in the right ear, so the beat lands at 6.0 Hz. Length 65 seconds.

Headphones are required, since the two ears have to hear two different tones for the phantom beat to exist. Listen at a comfortable volume.

Cognistration is an exploration tool, not a medical device, and nothing here is a treatment for any condition. If you have a seizure disorder, tinnitus, or a hearing concern, talk to a clinician before experimenting with tones.
